title: Normalized scalar models for arbitrary sheaf-ring maps
statement:
For every map φ:R→S of commutative ring sheaves on the stated essentially small site, there is a normalized SystemScalarModel: the ordinary sheafified tensor functor and its actual scalar-restriction adjunction, the independent-coefficient derived tensor model, a derived adjunction to exact restriction, the pure-tensor unit formula, and the normalized transpose formula on every cochain complex. Exact scalar restriction and the derived-category instances are the original constructions.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
variable [EssentiallySmall.{w} C]
theorem nonempty_systemScalarModel {R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}} (φ : R ⟶ S) :
    Nonempty (SystemScalarModel φ)
```

proof.text: Use the existing independent-coefficient derived change-of-rings cochain model and the existing sheaf-ring coefficient adjunction normalization. The ordinary unit is the explicit local map x↦1⊗x, and the cochain transpose formula is exactly the normalized derived coefficient adjunction. Package these specified data without choosing an arbitrary existence witness for an ordinary tensor object.
